versions.content: If SdSubscribeEventgroupRetryEnable is set to TRUE and SubscribeEventgroupRetryMax is set to 0xFF, the r etries of subscription shall continue as long as all of the following conditions are fulfilled:  the corresponding Eventgroup is set to " SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_REQUESTED "  no SubscribeEventGroupAck or no SubscribeEventGroupNack was received

If SdSubscribeEventgroupRetryEnable is set to TRUE and SubscribeEventgroupRetryMax is set to 0xFF, the r etries of subscription shall continue as long as all of the following conditions are fulfilled:  the corresponding Eventgroup is set to " SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_REQUESTED "  no SubscribeEventGroupAck or no SubscribeEventGroupNack was received

If SdSubscribeEventgroupRetryEnable is set to TRUE and Sub- scribeEventgroupRetryMax is set to 0xFF, the retries of subscription shall continue as long as all of the following conditions are fulfilled: • the corresponding Eventgroup is set to "SD_CONSUMED_EVENTGROUP_RE- QUESTED" • no SubscribeEventGroupAck or no SubscribeEventGroupNack was received
